title: Northern Qi
capsule: Northern Qi (550-577 CE) was one of the Northern Dynasties of China, founded by Gao Yang when he usurped the throne of Eastern Wei. Based in the eastern North China Plain with its capital at Ye, it was known for both cultural achievement and political turbulence. It was conquered by its western rival Northern Zhou in 577.
